interpretation: The author reported reviewing all 46 frozen event-v3 cases and confirming their classifications. A subsequent source-based technical audit identified scope, frontloading and incidental-stage discrepancies. The original report is preserved; it is not transferred to changed classifications or the entire corrected analysis. This is an author-involved unblinded historical check, not independent validation or a population-accuracy estimate.
limitations: Individual criterion-form responses were not supplied.
The collective report does not establish 414 separately elicited judgments.
Unequal coverage sampling and author/rule-design involvement limit generalization.
recording_granularity: Collective author statement covering the frozen 46-event set.
sample_design: One event per nonempty condition × station × canonical-provider cell.
